Name: Spouse Errands -Lasting Assignments and Household Help
Description:
Once a farm is established, restocking wood, stone, coal and everyday ingredients can still take time away from larger projects. [size=4][color=#ffff00][font=Arial Black]Married spouses can also play a more practical role in that routine[/font][/color].[/size]
This mod connects those needs: give your partner a lasting assignment and share part of the recurring workload.

The focus: arrange it once, see them leave and return, and receive supplies where they belong.
Designed for players who prefer building, exploring and long-term farming projects over repeated supply runs. Free groceries, automatic collection and ingredient-free meals are intentional conveniences that increase resource availability. Adjust or disable them to suit your game.

Three lasting assignments
• Gathering: [color=#00ff00]mixed wood, stone, fiber, hardwood and moss[/color]. The default base budget is 60–70; moss and hardwood consume larger shares.
• Mining: [color=#00ff00]coal and ores [/color]share a default base budget of 50–60. Mine and region progress restrict ore availability. Iridium and radioactive ore consume larger shares of the budget.
• Shopping: free, [color=#00ff00]automatically mixed normal-quality vegetables, common fish, fruit, pantry supplies, eggs and dairy.[/color] The default base quantity is 6–8 items, delivered to the farmhouse's main fridge. Continuous restocking is supported. Legendary fish, night-market-exclusive fish, ancient fruit and sweet gem berries are excluded.
[color=#ffff00][size=4]Each spouse performs one available task per day without daily reassignment. Use household defaults or individual assignments. This mod does not itself enable additional marriages.[/size][/color]
[line]

[color=#9900ff]A visible daily routine[/color]
Spouses start leaving at 08:00 by default, walk toward a farm exit and disappear once away. They begin returning at 17:30 and deliver when they actually enter the farmhouse. Observable travel segments remain visible when players are nearby.
Once departure begins, that day's assignment is locked. Reassignment, cancellation and household pause cannot change it mid-trip. Set future assignments after the spouse returns. Going to bed early still settles valid work, so there is no need to wait around for delivery.

[color=#9900ff]Help at home
[/color]Unassigned spouses help at wake-up by [color=#00ff00]watering, petting animals and collecting animal products and farm-cave forage or mushrooms.[/color] Eligible spouses prepare lunch at 12:00 and dinner at 18:00 without consuming ingredients. A spouse who has started an outdoor assignment does not also cook that day.
Rain pauses work and collection by default, while eligible cooking continues. Rainy-day work can be enabled in settings.

[color=#9900ff]Optional weekly world-forage collection[/color]
Enabled by default, [color=#00ff00]this side activity collects existing forage and digs artifact spots in eligible, unlocked Valley, Beach, Desert and Island areas on Saturdays[/color]. It removes actual objects from those maps rather than creating duplicate rewards.
Rain can bring collection forward by up to three days. Weather is reconsidered when rain totems change it. If the earlier date has passed, collection can catch up on a workable day; otherwise that week is skipped. Disable or configure this activity in the settings menu.

[color=#9900ff]Automatic delivery without chest binding[/color]
Resources, cooked meals and collected items go to the [color=#00ff00]nearest eligible outdoor farm chest or big chest[/color], measured from the farmhouse door. Purchased ingredients go to the main fridge.
Generated errand goods wait if the receiving container is missing or in use. Excess items are lost with a notification when it is full; the mod does not switch to a farther chest. Without a usable farm chest, morning animal and cave products remain where they are.

[color=#ff00ff]Installation and controls[/color]
Requires SMAPI. Extract SpouseErrands into Mods. The first SMAPI startup writes a complete config.json.
Press [color=#ff0000]Shift + H [/color]to open the assignment menu; the keybind is configurable. Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support includes quantities, weather, meal choices and foraging regions, with detailed hover explanations and Reset to Default on the main page.
The host controls assignments, production and travel. Clients should install the same version for extra interaction messages and away-spouse map-marker hiding. Marker hiding integrates with optional NPC Map Locations. The three custom mods do not require each other.
Created by GPT6.
[line]

农场逐渐成形后，[color=#ffffff]木头、石头、煤炭和日常食材的补给仍会反复占用时间[/color]；
[color=#ffff00][size=5]婚后的配偶也可以在这段经营生活中承担更明确的作用。[/size][/color]
本模组把这两件事放在一起：给伴侣一个持续执行的安排，让每天都要重复处理的一部分杂事有人分担。

核心体验：安排一次，持续协作；看得见出门回家，物资自动送到该去的地方。
它适合更喜欢建设、探索和长期经营，希望减少后期琐碎劳动的玩家。免费采购、自动收取和不消耗食材的餐食是有意提供的便利，会提高日常资源获取量，可按喜好调整或关闭。
[line]

[color=#9900ff]三种长期委托[/color]
• 采集资源：[color=#00ff00]混合获取木头、石头、纤维、硬木和苔藓。[/color]基础总额度默认 60～70，苔藓与硬木占用更多额度。
• 采矿：[color=#00ff00]煤炭与矿石[/color]共享基础总额度，默认 50～60。铁、金等矿物受矿井进度限制，铱矿与放射性矿石还需要对应地区进度；稀有矿占用更多额度。
• 采购：[color=#00ff00]免费自动搭配普通品质蔬菜、常见鱼、水果、烹饪配料和蛋奶制品。[/color]基础采购量默认 6～8 件，直接送入农舍默认冰箱，可持续补货。排除鱼王、夜市专属鱼、上古水果和宝石甜莓。
[color=#ffff00][size=5]每位配偶每天执行一项可行委托，无需每天重新派活。支持对各配偶分别安排，也可设定全家默认任务。模组本身不会增加可结婚人数。[/size][/color]

早出晚归，而不是只有一条奖励消息
默认 08:00 开始出门，沿农场路线走到边缘后隐藏；17:30 开始返程，实际进入农舍时交货。若在观察范围内，会保留可见出入路段。
出发后当天委托锁定，不能中途改派、取消或通过全家暂停绕过限制；归来后可调整后续安排。提前睡觉也会补结算当天有效任务，避免为了等收货而空耗时间。

[color=#9900ff]留家也有事可做[/color]
未安排外出的配偶在[color=#00ff00]起床时协助浇水、抚摸动物、收取动物制品及农场洞穴采集物和蘑菇[/color]；12:00 做午饭，18:00 做晚饭，不消耗食材。当天已开始执行外出委托的配偶不兼任做饭。
雨天默认暂停工作和收取，只保留符合条件的做饭；可在配置中开启雨天工作。

[color=#9900ff]可选的每周野外收取[/color]
野外采集副选项默认开启，[color=#00ff00]周六清理已开放、符合条件的山谷、沙滩、沙漠及姜岛地图中的实际采集物，并挖掘远古斑点。它会改变地图上的现有物件[/color]，不是凭空复制一份。
雨天会动态尝试提前，最多提前三天；雨水图腾改变天气后重新判断。错过提前日时，当天还能工作则补收，否则本周跳过。该功能可在配置菜单关闭。

[color=#9900ff]自动收货，无需绑定箱子[/color]
普通资源、餐食和收取物[color=#00ff00]投递到离农舍门口最近的农场室外普通箱子或大箱子[/color]，采购食材进入默认冰箱。
容器缺失或被占用时，已经生成的委托货物暂存等待；满箱时多余物品会丢失并提示，不会自动改投更远的箱子。无可用收货箱时，晨间动物及洞穴现有产物留在原处。

[color=#ff00ff]安装与使用[/color]
需要 SMAPI。将 SpouseErrands 文件夹放入 Mods，使用 SMAPI 首次启动会生成完整 config.json。
默认 Shift + H 打开指令菜单，按键可配置。Generic Mod Config Menu 可选，提供数量、天气、午晚餐、采集区域等设置，首页底部可重置为默认。操作规则的详细说明放在配置悬停提示中。
主机负责安排、产物和移动。客户端若需额外互动文字及外出头像隐藏，也应安装相同版本；头像隐藏适配 NPC Map Locations，后者不是必需依赖。三款自定义模组互不依赖。
由GPT6制作.
